targets.query:
from(bucket: "LabEEE")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ambiente" and (r._field == "temp_c" or r._field == "co2_ppm"))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "agora", _field: (if r._field == "temp_c" then "temp_" else "co2_") + r.serie, _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["k"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["k"])

// Estado de janelas e portas. 1 = aberta, 0 = fechada, 2 = indisponível.
// O Home Assistant publica o estado de todos os sensores a cada 10 min (automação "Publicar janelas e portas no MQTT").
from(bucket: "LabEEE")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "janela" and (r._field == "aberta" or r._field == "disponivel"))
  |> group(columns: ["nome", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nome"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "agora", _field: "janela_" + r.nome, _value: if r.disponivel == 0.0 then 2.0 else r.aberta}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["k"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["k"])
